first_valid_rule: For each judge, preserve and hash-seal the first complete schema-valid raw JSON. Do not ask the judge to revise scores after a valid judgment.
transport_only_normalization: If UI transport wraps JSON in a markdown code fence, preserve raw transport text and remove only the outer fence for parsing.
HTML entity decoding is allowed only when the UI visibly encoded JSON characters; preserve both raw and normalized hashes.
Removal of UI line-ending escape backslashes is allowed only when demonstrably transport-generated; preserve raw and normalized hashes.
No numeric score, preference, reconstruction text, critical label, or evidence string may be substantively edited.
premapping_gate: Coordinator mapping MUST NOT be accessed or revealed until J01/J02/J03 first schema-valid judgments are all hash-sealed.
invalid_output_rule: If output is schema-invalid, preserve it as invalid evidence. A judge may be asked only to repair schema/serialization omissions without seeing mapping, other judges, or outcome calculations. Do not coach scores.
mapping_application: After 3/3 valid raw judgments are sealed, reveal coordinator mapping once and compute the frozen PA8-E gates.
